vector_memory.semantic_summary: This module provides pure, stateless rendering utilities designed to convert internal application state and structured events into formatted, ANSI-encoded strings. Its primary role is to act as the presentation layer for the chat UI, decoupling rendering logic from the core framework. It handles the visualization of user messages, agent thoughts, tool calls, and dynamic status updates using specific formatting helpers. It is designed to be thread-safe for patching stdout in a raw mode.
